r.정치 구도: At war since 2014. The Houthi rebels hold the north, while the internationally recognized government and separatists divide the south.

t.why: It lies on the Bab el-Mandeb strait at the mouth of the Red Sea, so Houthi attacks on ships have disrupted world shipping.
t.rel: At war since 2014. The Houthi rebels who control the north are backed by Iran and have fought a Saudi-led coalition. The Houthis have also attacked ships passing through the Red Sea.
t.korea: Korea's foreign ministry has placed it under a level-4 travel ban.
t.know: Shibam is packed with 16th-century mud-brick high-rises and is called the 'Manhattan of the desert'.
t.etext: Civil war has destroyed the economy, and many people depend on food aid. Oil exports have almost stopped.
